profile.name: Lazizbek Saidov
profile.headline: AI Product Developer & Full-Stack Builder
about: I build practical AI products and full-stack tools for real workflows, with a focus on clear interfaces, reliable systems, and measurable user value.
My public work spans legal technology, personal finance, and operational software—from product design and frontend engineering to APIs, data, and deployment.

research.narrative: I am exploring how AI can support high-context workflows without hiding uncertainty. My direction is to combine grounded domain logic, useful interfaces, and bounded automation so people can understand the system, verify its output, and act with confidence.
